meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 它会一直盯着某个 PR:反复查看 CI 检查、评论和未解决的 review 线程,修掉真实问题、跑测试并推送,直到检查通过且没有可处理评论才停。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、监控某个 PR,或让它持续检查评论、评审和 CI 直到所有可处理问题解决时触发。

say.text: 盯一下 #123 这个 PR,直到 CI 通过、评论都解决
say.note: 它会循环查状态,有问题就继续跟进

say.text: 看看这个 PR 还有哪些未解决的 review 评论
say.note: 会列出未解决线程及最近一条评论

say.text: 等 CI 跑完再告诉我结果,每轮都重新查一遍
say.note: 长检查期间它会保持轮询

howto.what_en: It stays on one pull request: it repeatedly checks CI, comments, and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and stops only when checks pass and no actionable comments or open threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to babysit or monitor a pull request, or to keep checking its comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until CI passes and all comments are resolved
say_en.note: It loops on status and keeps going while issues remain

say_en.text: Show the unresolved review threads on this PR
say_en.note: Lists open threads with the latest comment

say_en.text: Wait for CI to finish, then report results
say_en.note: It keeps polling while checks are pending
